scenes.text: One gram of this spice takes about one hundred and fifty flowers.
Each flower blooms for only a few days a year — and holds just three crimson threads.
Every thread is picked by hand, at dawn, before the sun can fade it.
Then slow-dried, until deep red turns to liquid gold.
A few threads are all a chef needs, to turn simple rice into something unforgettable.
Saffron. The most expensive spice on Earth — and now, you know why.
